State (Tennessee).title: SB 7: Boats, Boating - As introduced, enacts the "Tennessee Certificate of Title for Vessels Act;" beginning July 1, 2028, requires each owner of a vessel to apply for a certificate of title for the vessel to the wildlife resources agency; establishes a Local Abandoned Vessel Prevention Fund to award grants to local governments for the costs of removal or recovery of abandoned vessels from the waters of Tennessee; makes other related revisions. - Amends TCA Title 10, Chapter 7, Part 5; Section 47-9-311; Title 55 and Title 69.
State (Tennessee).short_title: Boats, Boating - As introduced, enacts the "Tennessee Certificate of Title for Vessels Act;" beginning July 1, 2028, requires each owner of a vessel to apply for a certificate of title for the vessel to the wildlife resources agency; establishes a Local Abandoned Vessel Prevention Fund to award grants to local governments for the costs of removal or recovery of abandoned vessels from the waters of Tennessee; makes other related revisions. - Amends TCA Title 10, Chapter 7, Part 5; Section 47-9-311; Title 55 and Title 69.
